documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Intimation About Expansion Of Product Portfolio To 400 Kv Transformer Segment

analysis.summary: Indo Tech Transformers Limited released its investor presentation for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, reporting strong financial and operational performance including FY26 revenue of ₹782 Cr and PAT of ₹93 Cr. Management highlighted high capacity utilization of 80-90% alongside an executable order book of ₹1,318 Cr and an ongoing ₹495 Cr phased capacity expansion plan targeting 50,000 MVA by FY29. The company also showcased strong financial resilience with zero net debt, improved debtor days of 56, and cash balances exceeding ₹114 Cr. Indo Tech Transformers reported strong financial growth for FY2026, with revenue reaching 782 crores and PAT expanding to 93 crores. Management highlighted a phased capacity expansion plan targeting 50,000 MVA by FY29 with a total capex of 495 crores.
